title: Parameter
description: design/developers/plugin_model.md §3 (Parameter object): one parameter of a Cmd (cmd.schema.json) or of a LinkDef's `parameters` (linkdef.schema.json -- 'same shape as Cmd parameters, except `init` is not used there'). Restructured from iox-vscode-plugin's commands.schema.json's inline `params[]` item shape, which lacks `optional`/`init`/`desc` entirely -- those are added here to match the real spec. Note `id` deliberately does NOT use id.schema.json: the spec states 'If empty string, this is the default parameter (and the only required parameter)', so an empty string must validate.

id.description: Parameter ID. If empty string, this is the default parameter (and the only required parameter).

editor.description: The editor ID used for this parameter -- a reference into the top-level `editors` array, not an inline editor definition.

optional.description: If true, this parameter is optional when sending the command.

init.description: Property Id. If specified, the UI showing the command initializes its default value from this property.

name.description: Rarely set -- seems used only when the parameter id is non-empty.
